### What changed
| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `frontend/` | Next.js 15 + React 19 app |
| `frontend/lib/api.ts` | `getApiBaseUrl()` from `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` |
| `frontend/.env.example` | Placeholder API base (no secrets) |
| `frontend/app/tickets/**` | List / create / detail **stubs** |
| `spec/plan.md` | T02 marked complete |

Verified: `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass. Root `.gitignore` already ignores `frontend/node_modules`, `.next`, `.env.local`.

### Routes / components → acceptance criteria

| Route / component | Satisfies now | Deferred |
|-------------------|---------------|----------|
| `/` → redirect | Navigation entry | — |
| `/tickets` (`TicketsListPage`) | Route exists | FR2 list, FR6 search, FR7 filter (T11/T12) |
| `/tickets/new` (`NewTicketPage`) | Route exists; no status field (aligned with spec) | FR1 create (T11) |
| `/tickets/[id]` (`TicketDetailPage`) | Route + id param | FR3–FR5, transitions, FR10 (T11/T12) |
| `lib/api.ts` | Env-based base URL | REST helpers (T11+) |
| Shared layout nav | List / New links | Error alert (T11) |

**UI-visible Core Acceptance Criteria:** none fully met yet — intentional for T02 (“no real ticket UI”).

### Spec / UX flags
- Placeholder copy only; no invented dashboards or search-only routes.
- Create stub correctly omits status (server always opens as `OPEN`).
- Did **not** wire create/list/detail/PATCH/comments/search/filter — that would skip ahead of T02 and rebuild too much at once.

**Next UI task:** T11 (wire list + create + detail to live API) after backend endpoints exist (T04+).
